orientation_note: Q1 identity only (insertion axis = world z, vertical). The symmetry question is orthogonal to the rotated-axis question; a Q2 extension is possible later but is not part of this design.
task_anchor_note: The rotated-axis COMMON anchor, so the keyed arm REUSES the frozen rotated_Q1 seed rollouts rather than re-collecting.

circular_honest.note: Collector ignores d_axial in yaw; yaw channel is a flat nominal. alpha*=0 by symmetry AND by absence of rotation.

circular_placebo.note: Collector performs a FIXED yaw sweep (15 deg) independent of d_axial. alpha*=0 by symmetry, but rotation IS present in the marginal trajectory.

placebo_note: The fixed sweep is an exemplar of 'rotation present but uncorrelated with d_axial'. It does not need to replicate the exact keyed yaw profile; the decisive contrast is correlation, not amplitude.

contexts.demonstrations: N in {5, 10, 20} mixed demos, subsampled from the 30-mixed manifest via a FROZEN subset file (fewshot_subsets.json discipline)
contexts.perturbation_tests: 8 held-out isolated interventions (+-30deg, +-15deg yaw; +-0.015 x/y) plus the zero baseline

success_criteria.M2_symmetry_discrimination_accuracy: classify fit as keyed iff alpha_yaw^pre > 0.5; target 100% for Pdiag at every N, chance for Frame-weighted/Phase-scalar-GP
success_criteria.M2b_symmetry_gap: G_psi = alpha_yaw^pre(keyed) - alpha_yaw^pre(circular); ideal G_psi*=1; headline = placebo gap G_psi^placebo ~ 1
success_criteria.M0_switch_fidelity: keyed arm reproduces the frozen 0.5-crossing transition location

collection_policy.env_change_note: phase_switch_symmetry_env.py gained a keyed:bool flag (default True preserves keyed geometry) and a second @register_env wrapper. The reused keyed arm H5 files are unaffected; the keyed geometry is byte-for-byte preserved under keyed=True.
